name: image-viewer
title: Image viewer
description: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and SVG with wheel zoom, drag pan, fit and temporary highlights. Tools: image_zoom, image_pan, image_fit, image_annotate, image_describe (metadata only, never pixels).
docs: The file contract is text: SVG shows from its text, a raster stored as a data:image URL shows as is, other raster files need a source(address, revision) URL your application serves.
